notes.title: Dandy Dungeon II: The Phantom Bride Out Now!
notes.content:

Today's update adds:

[list][*] Oodles of content: more than 90 dungeon types, over 560 weapons & armor and 260+ monsters!
[*] Over 130 tracks of chiptunes and middle-aged men humming! 
[*] Heaven’s Door: a 99-floor, post-game challenge dungeon, BRAND-NEW to the world of [i]Dandy Dungeon[/i]! We can't wait to witness the methods to your madness as you try to tackle this tower!
[*] It's got [url=https://twitter.com/oniongames/status/1243593153480974338][i]Final Fantasy[/i] and Mistwalker composer Nobuo Uematsu[/url], as you've... never seen him before!

[*] It's even got [url=http://dandydungeon.com/sub/collaboration.html]a throwback to our upcoming release of [i]Moon[/i][/url], with that game's composers, the Thelonious Monkeys![/list]

If you don't already own the game, we have you covered! We're now offering a HUGE discount for new players! The lowest price we've ever offered it for! The game is now just 

[list][*] $13.29 in the U.S.! 
[*] €11.19 in Europe!

And that's not even all! 

Do you have a friend and/or loved one who you think would love [i]Dandy Dungeon[/i], but just wasn't quite ready to take the leap? Well, now they can, because we've just released a [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1138970/Dandy_Dungeon__Legend_of_Brave_Yamada/]FREE DEMO VERSION ON STEAM[/url]! 

We feel like all it takes is one little taste to fall head-over-heels for our strange little rogue-lite, so we're giving everyone the chance to get that taste!

notes.title: Version 1.1.6 has been released!
notes.content:
The following bug has been fixed:
-Leaderboards not appearing.

For all our players on Mac:

Due to a bug with our leaderboards, Mac players must change the location of their save data, or the data will not load and the game will start again from the beginning.

If you'd like to manually move your save data and avoid this, please follow the steps below:

1.) Display your Mac's hidden folders by pressing [command] + [shift] + [.] in Finder.

2.) Find your old savedata in the folder below: /Users/YOUR_USER_NAME/Library/Containers/jp.oniongames.dandydungeon/Data/Library/Application Support/jp.oniongames.dandydungeon

3.) Copy and paste the savedata.dat into the folder below:
/Users/YOUR_USER_NAME/Library/Application Support/DMM/DandyDungeon

4.) Hide your hidden folders again by pressing [command] + [shift] + [.] in Finder.

* PLEASE NOTE! * Making any other changes to your hidden folders can cause unexpected issues, so please be careful following the steps above!

Want to report new bugs? Find our support thread here to help us track down any problems: https://steamcommunity.com/app/1138970/discussions/0/1743386672809011770/

You can also find us in our Discord channel, right over here: https://discord.gg/Uhc5pQK

Thanks to all our players for helping us make our games the best they can be!
 
日本語版

リーダーボードが表示されないバグを修正しました。

『mac版バージョン1.1.6のアップデートについて』

ランキングが表示されない不具合を修正するにあたり、セーブデータの位置を変える必要がございました。大変申し訳ございませんが、更新後、基本的には、”はじめから"遊んでください。


<特別な対処方法>
どうしても最初からやり直したくない場合は、自己責任にて以下の方法をお試しください。古いセーブデータを新しい位置に移動することによりプレイ可能となります

[セーブデータ復帰手順]
1)隠しフォルダを表示する。
Finderの上で [command] + [shift] + [.(ドット)] を押してください。


2)旧セーブデータを見つけてる。

savedata.datを以下のフォルダーから探してください
/Users/user_name/Library/Containers/jp.oniongames.dandydungeon/Data/Library/Application Support/jp.oniongames.dandydungeon


3) savedata.datをコピーする

以下のフォルダーにコピーしてください
/Users/user_name/Library/Application Support/DMM/DandyDungeon

4)隠しフォルダーを非表示にもどす
作業終了後は隠しフォルダの設定を元に戻しましょう。
もう一度、 [command] + [shift] + [.(ドット)] を押しますと隠しフォルダは見えなくなりま す。

**注意!!
隠しフォルダーの内容変更は様々な問題を起こす可能性があります。かならず自己責任でお願いします。
